services.name: Rear bumper repair
services.story: The same claim, with the $500 deductible on the bill Rosie texts with READY, so Alex can pay before pick-up.

services.name: Rear bumper repair

services.name: Rear bumper repair
services.story: The same repair paid by Alex, with the rest on the bill Rosie texts with READY.

services.name: Headlight restoration
services.story: A $35 headlight restoration from the shop's board, the example shop's own price. Nothing is taken: a YES books the drop-off, and Alex pays at the counter at pick-up the same day.

services.name: Hail dent repair

services.name: Door and fender dent repair
services.story: A dented door and fender, priced at the car. Only the $89 travel fee is promised, taken off the repair. Rosie texts the bill at DONE.

services.name: Door ding repair
services.story: A $179 door ding repair from Sam's list, the example's own price. Nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the bill when Tony texts DONE.
